agent_explanation: Seeded sensor noise (~0.018) corrupts angle/rate feedback to the state-feedback controller. Controller reacts to phantom errors with large saturated forces (67.78 N at steps 15,17,18), pumping energy (0.77J to 36.5J) and driving cart velocity to ~8 m/s and omega to ~-9.9 rad/s. Positive feedback diverges theta from -0.05 to -0.896 rad by step 18, violating pole_upright. Removing noise alone stabilizes the run.
